SELECT 
  EmployeeId,
  City,
  customer_count,
  ratio_to_city_avg,
  ratio_to_total
FROM (
  WITH step1 AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerId, e.EmployeeId, e.City
    FROM Customer c
    INNER JOIN Employee e ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId
  ),
  step2 AS (
    SELECT EmployeeId, City, COUNT(*) as customer_count
    FROM step1
    GROUP BY EmployeeId, City
  ),
  step3 AS (
    SELECT City, AVG(customer_count) as city_avg
    FROM step2
    GROUP BY City
  ),
  step4 AS (
    SELECT 
      s2.EmployeeId,
      s2.City,
      s2.customer_count,
      CAST(s2.customer_count AS REAL) / s3.city_avg as ratio_to_city_avg
    FROM step2 s2
    JOIN step3 s3 ON s2.City = s3.City
  ),
  step5 AS (
    SELECT SUM(customer_count) as total_count
    FROM step4
  ),
  step6 AS (
    SELECT 
      s4.EmployeeId,
      s4.City,
      s4.customer_count,
      s4.ratio_to_city_avg,
      CAST(s4.customer_count AS REAL) / s5.total_count as ratio_to_total
    FROM step4 s4
    CROSS JOIN step5 s5
    WHERE s5.total_count IS NOT NULL
  )
  SELECT 
    EmployeeId,
    City,
    customer_count,
    ratio_to_city_avg,
    ratio_to_total
  FROM step6
  ORDER BY ratio_to_total IS NULL, ratio_to_total DESC
  LIMIT 10
)
